course: Small Machines & Pharmaceuticals: The Complete Import Business

lessons.title: Sea Freight: FCL vs LCL
lessons.body:
Sea freight is the backbone of importing from China to Africa. It's cheap but slow. You'll choose between FCL (Full Container Load) and LCL (Less Than Container Load). FCL means you rent the entire containerâtypically a 20ft or 40ft. LCL means you share a container with other importers; you pay for the volume your goods occupy.

For small machines, a 20ft container holds about 28 cubic meters (CBM) and can carry up to 25 tons. A 40ft holds about 58 CBM but weight limit is similar. If your goods fill more than 15 CBM, FCL is usually cheaper. For pharmaceuticals, volume is small but weight can be high; check both.

LCL is priced per CBM or per ton, whichever is greater. From China to Lagos, LCL rates range from $80 to $150 per CBM. FCL from Shanghai to Lagos costs $2,500â$4,500 for a 20ft. To Mombasa, $2,000â$3,500. To Durban, $1,800â$3,000. These are port-to-port; add local charges.

LCL takes longer because of consolidation and deconsolidation. Expect 35â50 days door-to-door. FCL is faster: 25â35 days. For urgent goods, sea is not your friend. Also, LCL cargo is handled more, increasing damage risk. For fragile machines, FCL is safer.

Choose FCL if you have enough volume, want faster transit, and lower damage risk. Choose LCL if you're testing a new product or have small shipments. Always get quotes for both and compare total landed cost, including destination charges like THC, customs clearance, and delivery. Many African ports have high terminal handling charges; factor those in.

lessons.title: Air Freight for Urgent and High-Value Goods
lessons.body:
Air freight is fast but expensive. Use it for urgent pharmaceuticals, high-value small machines, or when you need to restock quickly. Transit time from China to major African airports is 3â7 days. Rates are based on chargeable weight: actual weight or volumetric weight (volume in cm Ã· 6000), whichever is higher.

For example, a box 50x40x30 cm has volumetric weight of 50*40*30/6000 = 10 kg. If actual weight is 8 kg, you pay for 10 kg. Air freight rates from Guangzhou to Lagos range from $4 to $8 per kg. To Nairobi, $3.5â$7 per kg. To Johannesburg, $3â$6 per kg. These are for general cargo; dangerous goods or temperature-controlled pharma cost more.

Air freight is ideal for pharmaceuticals that are temperature-sensitive. You can book with airlines like Ethiopian Airlines, Kenya Airways, or Emirates SkyCargo. They offer cold chain options. But you must ensure proper packaging and documentation. For small machines, air freight is only economical if the machine is high value and low weight.

Always compare air freight to express courier for small shipments. For 50 kg, air freight might be cheaper than DHL. But air freight requires customs clearance at destination, which can add time and cost. Use a freight forwarder to handle it. Also, note that fuel surcharges and security fees fluctuate; get an all-in quote.

For urgent goods, air freight is your best bet. But plan ahead: book early, especially during peak seasons like Christmas. Consider splitting shipments: send critical parts by air, bulk by sea. This balances cost and speed.

lessons.title: Express Courier for Small Shipments
lessons.body:
Express couriers like DHL, FedEx, UPS, and Aramex are the fastest way to ship small parcels from China to Africa. They handle door-to-door delivery, customs clearance, and tracking. Ideal for samples, small spare parts, or urgent documents. But they are expensive: expect $15â$30 per kg for 5â20 kg shipments.

For example, sending a 5 kg box from Shenzhen to Lagos via DHL costs about $120â$180. To Nairobi, $100â$150. To Accra, $130â$200. Rates depend on weight, dimensions, and destination. Volumetric weight applies: divide volume in cm by 5000 for express couriers (different from air freight). So a 40x30x20 cm box has volumetric weight of 40*30*20/5000 = 4.8 kg. If actual weight is 3 kg, you pay for 4.8 kg.

Express couriers are best for shipments under 50 kg. Above that, air freight or sea freight becomes cheaper. Also, express couriers have limits on dangerous goods; pharmaceuticals may require special handling and documentation. Some couriers have specific services for healthcare shipments.

Use express courier when you need speed and reliability. They provide tracking numbers, so you can monitor your shipment. But be aware of customs duties and taxes; the courier will often pay on your behalf and bill you later, adding a fee. Always declare accurate values to avoid delays.

For small machines, if you need a critical part urgently, express courier is the way. But for regular restocking, plan ahead and use sea or air freight. Negotiate rates with couriers if you ship regularly; they offer discounts for volume.

lessons.title: Freight Costs from China to Africa
lessons.body:
Freight costs vary widely by route, mode, and season. Let's break down typical costs from major Chinese ports to key African destinations. All rates are in USD and are indicative; always get current quotes.

Sea freight FCL: Shanghai to Lagos: 20ft $2,500â$4,500, 40ft $4,000â$7,000. To Mombasa: 20ft $2,000â$3,500, 40ft $3,500â$5,500. To Durban: 20ft $1,800â$3,000, 40ft $3,000â$5,000. To Tema: similar to Lagos. These are port-to-port; add THC (Terminal Handling Charges) at both ends, customs clearance, and inland transport. Destination charges in Africa can be $1,000â$2,000 per container.

Sea freight LCL: Rates per CBM from China to Lagos: $80â$150. To Mombasa: $70â$130. To Durban: $60â$120. Minimum charge often 1 CBM. Add destination fees like CFS (Container Freight Station) charges, which can be $50â$100 per CBM.

Air freight: Rates per kg from China to Lagos: $4â$8. To Nairobi: $3.5â$7. To Johannesburg: $3â$6. Add fuel surcharge (10â20% of base rate) and security fee ($0.10â$0.20 per kg). Minimum charge often 45 kg.

Express courier: Rates per kg from China to Lagos: $15â$30 for 5â20 kg. To Nairobi: $12â$25. To Accra: $18â$35. Minimum charge for 0.5 kg is about $30â$50.

Other costs: Insurance (0.3â0.5% of cargo value), documentation fees ($50â$150), and customs duties (varies by country, often 5â35% of CIF value). Always ask for an all-in quote to avoid surprises.

lessons.title: Freight Forwarders and Consolidators
lessons.body:
A freight forwarder is your shipping agent. They arrange transport, handle customs, and consolidate shipments. A consolidator groups multiple small shipments into one container (LCL). Using a forwarder saves time and headaches, especially for new importers.

Choose a forwarder with experience in your route and goods. For pharmaceuticals, they must know temperature control and regulatory requirements. For machines, they should handle heavy lift and breakbulk. Ask for references and check if they are licensed by customs. In Africa, use forwarders with local presence at destination to clear goods smoothly.

How to find a forwarder: search online for 'freight forwarder China to Nigeria' or 'consolidator China to Kenya'. Platforms like Freightos, iContainers, or Alibaba's logistics service can give instant quotes. But for Africa, local forwarders may be better because they understand the terrain. Ask other importers for recommendations.

A good forwarder will: provide a clear quote with all charges, advise on documentation, track your shipment, and handle customs. They may also offer warehousing and distribution. Fees vary: for LCL, they charge per CBM plus destination fees. For FCL, a flat fee per container. Expect to pay $100â$300 for documentation and clearance on top of freight.

Always get multiple quotes. Compare not just price but service. A cheap forwarder may cut corners, leading to delays and extra costs. Build a relationship with a reliable forwarder; they can become your logistics partner as you grow.

lessons.title: Tracking Your Shipment
lessons.body:
Tracking your shipment is crucial to avoid losses and plan your cash flow. Every mode has a tracking system. For sea freight, you get a Bill of Lading (B/L) number. Use it on the shipping line's website (e.g., Maersk, MSC, CMA CGM) to see vessel position and estimated arrival. For LCL, your forwarder gives you a House B/L; they can provide updates.

For air freight, you get an Air Waybill (AWB) number. Track it on the airline's website (e.g., Ethiopian Airlines, Emirates SkyCargo) or on tracking sites like track-trace.com. For express courier, you get a tracking number to use on DHL, FedEx, or UPS websites. They provide real-time updates.

Always ask for the tracking number as soon as your goods are shipped. For sea freight, note that tracking may only show port-to-port; inland transit may not be covered. Your forwarder should give you updates. Set up alerts on the shipping line's website to get notifications.

If tracking shows no movement for several days, contact your forwarder. Delays can happen due to port congestion, customs, or weather. In Africa, ports like Lagos and Mombasa can be congested; factor in extra time. Also, track your container's location using the container number on sites like container-tracking.org.

Keep records of all tracking numbers and correspondence. If goods are lost or damaged, you'll need them for insurance claims. Consider using a shipment tracking app or spreadsheet to manage multiple shipments. Proactive tracking helps you prepare customs documents and arrange pickup, avoiding demurrage charges.

quiz.q: What does FCL stand for in shipping?
quiz.explanation: FCL means Full Container Load, where you rent the entire container.

quiz.q: Which mode of transport is generally the cheapest for large shipments?
quiz.explanation: Sea freight is the most cost-effective for large volumes, though slower.

quiz.q: What is the volumetric weight formula for air freight?
options: A) Length x Width x Height / 5000
B) Length x Width x Height / 6000
C) Length x Width x Height / 4000
D) Length x Width x Height / 7000
quiz.explanation: Air freight uses volumetric weight calculated as volume in cm divided by 6000.

quiz.q: Which courier is known for express door-to-door delivery?
quiz.explanation: DHL is a major express courier offering door-to-door service.

quiz.q: What is the typical transit time for sea freight from China to Africa?
quiz.explanation: Sea freight from China to Africa typically takes 25-50 days depending on route and mode.

quiz.q: What is a Bill of Lading?
options: A) A tracking number for air freight
B) A document for sea freight
quiz.explanation: A Bill of Lading is a key document in sea freight, serving as a receipt and contract.

quiz.q: For LCL shipments, what is the typical unit of pricing?
quiz.explanation: LCL rates are usually per cubic meter (CBM) or per ton, whichever is greater.

quiz.q: Which of these is a freight forwarder?
quiz.explanation: Kuehne+Nagel is a global freight forwarder, while others are carriers or couriers.

quiz.q: What is the chargeable weight for express courier volumetric calculation?
quiz.explanation: Express couriers often use volume in cm divided by 5000 for volumetric weight.

quiz.q: Which African port is a major destination for goods from China?
quiz.explanation: Lagos, Nigeria is one of the busiest ports in Africa for imports from China.

quiz.q: What does LCL stand for?
quiz.explanation: LCL means Less than Container Load, where you share container space.

quiz.q: Which mode is best for urgent, high-value, small shipments?
quiz.explanation: Air freight is fast and suitable for urgent, high-value goods.

quiz.q: What is a common destination charge for sea freight in Africa?
quiz.explanation: THC is a common destination charge at African ports.

quiz.q: Which tracking document is used for air freight?
quiz.explanation: Air Waybill (AWB) is the tracking document for air freight.

quiz.q: What is a consolidator?
options: A) A company that fills containers
B) A company that groups small shipments
quiz.explanation: A consolidator groups multiple small shipments into one container for LCL.

quiz.q: For sea freight, what is the typical weight limit for a 20ft container?
quiz.explanation: A 20ft container can typically carry up to 25 tons, depending on regulations.

quiz.q: Which of these is a freight tracking website?
quiz.explanation: track-trace.com allows tracking of shipments across various carriers.

quiz.q: What is demurrage?
options: A) A fee for late container pickup
quiz.explanation: Demurrage is a charge for keeping a container at the port beyond free time.

quiz.q: Which airline is known for cargo services to Africa?
quiz.explanation: Ethiopian Airlines has a significant cargo network in Africa.

quiz.q: What is the typical cost range for express courier from China to Lagos per kg?
quiz.explanation: Express courier rates from China to Lagos are typically $15-$30 per kg.

quiz.q: What is a House Bill of Lading?
options: A) Issued by the shipping line
B) Issued by the freight forwarder
quiz.explanation: A House Bill of Lading is issued by a freight forwarder for LCL shipments.

quiz.q: Which of these is a factor in air freight rates?
quiz.explanation: Fuel surcharge is a common additional fee in air freight.

quiz.q: What is the minimum charge for express courier for a small parcel?
quiz.explanation: Express couriers often have a minimum charge of $30-$50 for small parcels.

quiz.q: Which mode of transport is most affected by port congestion in Africa?
quiz.explanation: Sea freight is most affected by port congestion, causing delays.

quiz.q: What is the role of a freight forwarder?
options: B) To arrange shipping and customs
quiz.explanation: Freight forwarders arrange transportation, customs clearance, and logistics.

quiz.q: Which of these is a volumetric weight divisor for express couriers?
quiz.explanation: Express couriers typically use 5000 as the volumetric divisor.

quiz.q: What is the typical transit time for air freight from China to Africa?
quiz.explanation: Air freight from China to Africa usually takes 3-7 days.

quiz.q: Which document is essential for customs clearance?
quiz.explanation: Commercial invoice, packing list, and Bill of Lading are all essential for customs clearance.

quiz.q: What is the typical cost for LCL from China to Lagos per CBM?
quiz.explanation: LCL rates from China to Lagos are typically $80-$150 per CBM.

quiz.q: Why is tracking important for importers?
quiz.explanation: Tracking helps avoid demurrage, plan cash flow, and prepare customs documents.
